sources.snippet: Welcome to the Vulkan Gaussian Splatting documentation. This project is a testbed to explore and compare various approaches to real-time visualization of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and related evolutions using the Vulkan API.

sources.snippet: The vk_gaussian_splatting project is a Vulkan-based testbed designed for the real-time visualization and exploration of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [Kerbl2023] and its evolutions.

sources.title: Gaussian Splats Rendering in Vulkan: A Comprehensive Guide
sources.snippet: This tutorial demonstrates how to render 3D Gaussian Splats using Vulkan. Gaussian splatting is a novel approach to real-time radiance field rendering that represents scenes as collections of 3D Gaussians, enabling high-quality novel view synthesis at interactive frame rates.
